notes:
A big update with everything from the last few weeks of testing.

- Faster to open, and screens stay responsive while drives and transfers are checked
- Drones, RODEs, renamed cards and several backup drives of the same model are all handled properly
- When the internet is too unstable to upload, SafeStore says so and keeps re-checking Dropbox on its own
- Cards only show Verified once their backup check has finished, and the damaged-footage alert names the clips
- Clearer messages when a backup drive is unplugged, renamed or moved, with what to do next
